import pytest
from node import Node

if pytest.use_correct:
    from correct_python_programs.detect_cycle import detect_cycle
else:
    from python_programs.detect_cycle import detect_cycle


def test_attack_1():
    """Empty list (None head) must report no cycle, not crash."""
    assert not detect_cycle(None)


def test_attack_2():
    """Single node self-loop must be detected as cycle."""
    n = Node(0)
    n.successor = n
    assert detect_cycle(n)


def test_attack_3():
    """Even-length acyclic list must report no cycle, not crash."""
    n1 = Node(1)
    n2 = Node(2, n1)
    n3 = Node(3, n2)
    n4 = Node(4, n3)
    assert not detect_cycle(n4)


def test_attack_4():
    """Duplicate values but no cycle must not be reported as cycle (is vs ==)."""
    n1 = Node(1)
    n2 = Node(1, n1)
    n3 = Node(1, n2)
    assert not detect_cycle(n3)


def test_attack_5():
    """Tail pointing back to middle node must be detected."""
    n1 = Node(1)
    n2 = Node(2, n1)
    n3 = Node(3, n2)
    n4 = Node(4, n3)
    n5 = Node(5, n4)
    n1.successor = n3
    assert detect_cycle(n5)


def test_attack_6():
    """Tail pointing back to head (full cycle) must be detected."""
    n1 = Node(1)
    n2 = Node(2, n1)
    n3 = Node(3, n2)
    n1.successor = n3
    assert detect_cycle(n3)


def test_attack_7():
    """Chain leading into a self-loop at tail must be detected."""
    n1 = Node(1)
    n1.successor = n1
    n2 = Node(2, n1)
    n3 = Node(3, n2)
    assert detect_cycle(n3)


def test_attack_8():
    """Longer even-length acyclic list must report no cycle, not crash."""
    n1 = Node(1)
    n2 = Node(2, n1)
    n3 = Node(3, n2)
    n4 = Node(4, n3)
    n5 = Node(5, n4)
    n6 = Node(6, n5)
    assert not detect_cycle(n6)
